title: Order summary with tax breakdown
body: Finance needs an itemized order summary for receipts: subtotal, shipping, tax, and grand total as separate fields.

acceptance_criteria.text: An order_summary function returns subtotal, shipping, tax, and total as separate fields.
Tax is 8% of the merchandise subtotal; shipping is not taxed.
Tests cover an order with items and an empty order (all fields zero except shipping rules).
